target: Prospective world-class human sumo ring-outs on the provisional MMC profile. Scripted and learned opponents are development proxies. No human rounds or outcomes enter training or selection.
prospective_clocks: After freezing model finalists and their selection rule, collect 8 new independent W-tap mirror donor matches with request prefix elite-v1-sealed. Keep every eligible calendar. Validation never feeds optimizer, selection or opponent archive.
training: Affine direct control, one-hidden-layer MLP, recurrent network and a hybrid recurrent network with a W-tap cue prior. Optimize continuous weights by evolutionary policy search with terminal ring-out reward. Randomized balanced seats. Hard-coded opponents, frozen pressure champion and archived learned opponents. Keep W-tap and Hold-W in all selection evaluations.
selection: Rank frozen training candidates on development clocks by equal-weight family average and worst opponent (70% mean + 30% minimum). Choose one champion before prospective evaluation. Report all families with W-tap. A held-out loss cannot be used to pick a different winner.
diagnosis: Pressure wins head-on but gives smaller follow-up launch and permits immediate boxing returns; pure W-tap sacrifices forward pressure/contact braking during trades. Test if continuous state feedback can vary W, S, sprint, A/D, jump and click admission within rounds. Test against opponents that select hits and change direction, as well as simple controls.
native: Give each trained architecture a matched MMC screen against W-tap and Hold-W in both seats and at 0/80ms, then play the preselected champion against trade, jump-reset, lateral hit select and the prior learned pressure controller. Include Hypixel-like transfer and native boxing with a 2s defender opening. Independent repetitions. No human participation assumed.
boxing: First shared W-tap landmark at 3, 5 and 10 consecutive unanswered post-wake fresh hits, primed candidate history during actual W-tap inputs. Return including upgrade, inactivity above 1000 ms, remaining fresh hits/time and censoring. Native independent acquisition. No boxing promotion from sumo.
limits: 12 physical cores on host. Four simulation workers with serial GC and bounded JVM parallelism, reduce concurrency during native testing. Use spare main-lab slots. All competitive inference uses own-client observations and normal key bindings at <=20 CPS.
